description: This file defines the GreaterThanOperator class, which implements comparison logic for 'greater than' filter operations within the SuiteCRM JSON API filtering system. It provides methods to return filter and SQL representations and validate operators.

classes.name: GreaterThanOperator
classes.description: Implements a 'greater than' comparison operator for filtering, providing methods to generate filter tags, SQL operators, and validate input.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag 'gt' representing the 'greater than' operation.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '>' for 'greater than' comparison.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and delegates further validation to the parent class.
